blocks.title: Claude Code on the host, keel-web beside it
Workspaces the developer adds, selects and keeps

consultations.question: Are the functional goals and problems read correctly, and where does the keel-web process itself run once Claude Code runs on the host?
options: keel-web stays containerised, host paths reach it through a mount or a host-side helper
keel-web moves to the host as well, the container becomes a convenience only
undecided, treat it as a step 6 option
consultations.answer: keel-web itself moves to the host alongside Claude Code, so server, registry, transcript log and agent share one filesystem; compose stays as a development convenience. Distribution as an image is a constraint to keep open, not a deliverable of this ticket. Goals and problems confirmed as stated.

consultations.question: Is the split into b1 (host runtime and agent) and b2 (workspace management) the right cut, and is b1 first the right order?
options: Two blocks as proposed, b1 before b2
Two blocks, b2 before b1
One block for the whole ticket
A different cut
consultations.answer: Two blocks as proposed, b1 (host runtime and agent) before b2 (workspace management).

consultations.question: Does knowledge.md record the ticket correctly before the block zone starts?
options: Accept as written
Correct a goal, problem or answer first
consultations.answer: Accepted as written. Proceed to block b1, step 6.

consultations.question: Which solution options does b1 take: how 'not logged in' is detected, what happens to configDirectory, what happens to the container, and whether the SSE invariant is observed or enforced?
options: Auth: file probe / claude auth status --json / through the SDK with no pre-flight
configDirectory: keep as an explicit input passed into the agent env / delete it
Container: equal second path / delete / tests and CI only
SSE invariant: read in the log / asserted by an automated test
consultations.answer: Auth: no pre-flight probe; a start that fails before system:init ever arrived is classified as not logged in. configDirectory: kept, and now actually passed to the agent as Options.env spread over process.env. Container: kept for tests and CI only, no Claude login inside it, claude_config volume and the devcontainer Claude feature removed. SSE: the one-detach-per-reload invariant becomes an automated in-process test against the Hono router, no new route. Also agreed without a question: serve() binds 127.0.0.1 and vite's host: true is dropped.

consultations.question: Are the LikeC4 deployment model, the frozen contracts and the two ADRs right for b1? Everything after this is implemented against them.
options: Accept model, stubs and ADRs
Change something first
consultations.answer: Accepted: deployment model, the two frozen contract files, ADR 0009 and 0010, and carrying ADRs 0001 and 0002 onto this branch.

consultations.question: b1 must also freeze protocol/src/events.ts, because the meaning of auth_required changed. b2 will need the same file for WorkspaceSummary. Freeze it here and hand the claim over at b2's step 7, or treat the shared file as an overlap and jump back to 4?
options: Freeze in b1, hand the claim to b2 at its step 7
Jump back to 4 and recut the blocks
Leave the protocol comment as it is
consultations.answer: Freeze protocol/src/events.ts in b1 with the corrected auth_required contract. b2 re-freezes the same path with WorkspaceSummary at its own step 7 and takes the claim over then, which is safe because b1 is done before b2 reaches step 7.

consultations.question: Which solution options does b2 take: the shape of the wire type, where freshness comes from, how the remembered file is written and read, and whether the new mutation endpoints get a request gate?
options: Wire type: status plus reason / discriminated union
Freshness: cached view refreshed on read / everything async
File: node built-ins with rename / a dependency; corrupt file refuses to start / is set aside
Request gate: CSRF and Host allowlist / nothing beyond the localhost binding
consultations.answer: Wire type: discriminated union, ready carrying ticketRepository and tracker. Freshness: a cached synchronous view, refreshed when the list is read. Corrupt workspaces.json: refuse to start and name the file and the parse error. Request gate: nothing beyond the 127.0.0.1 binding, so the CSRF and DNS-rebinding gap is recorded as an open question instead.

consultations.question: Are the model change, the three frozen contracts and ADRs 0011 and 0012 right for b2? Everything after this is implemented against them.
options: Accept model, stubs and ADRs
Change something first
consultations.answer: Accepted: the two new server components, the three frozen contract files and ADRs 0011 and 0012.

consultations.question: attach waits for system:init, which the SDK only sends once the first turn begins. What does attach wait for instead, what does it return, and what becomes of SessionStartError?
options: Wait for nothing: register the session as soon as the run exists
Wait for startup(): the subprocess is up before attach returns
attach returns void / keeps returning a Session with an optional sessionId
SessionStartError and startTimeoutMs are dropped / kept for a different failure
consultations.answer: attach waits for nothing and returns Promise<void>. The Session interface, sessionId and pendingPermissions are removed with it, since nothing reads them. SessionStartError and startTimeoutMs are removed: without a wait there is no moment at which either could arise. UnknownWorkspaceError is the only rejection left; everything else reaches the browser as session.failed, as ADR 0010 intended.

consultations.question: Are the directory browser's model change, the three contracts and ADR 0014 right? Everything after this is implemented against them.
options: Accept model, stubs and ADR
Change something first
consultations.answer: Accepted: the directories and directoryPicker components, the three contracts and ADR 0014.

jump_log.reason: The meaning of the protocol's `auth_required` failure code changed with the host move: it no longer means the container has no login, it means the agent gave up before it was ready and any early failure lands there. protocol/src/events.ts was not among b1's frozen stubs at 7.2, so the change needed a step 7 decision rather than an implementation edit.

Found by running the chat in the browser against the real agent. attach waits for system:init, but the SDK only emits it once the first user message arrives (measured: hook_started at 0.3s, init at 15.2s, right after the message was released). send needs a session, so attach and send wait on each other until SessionStartError after 60s. The fake agent in the tests emitted init immediately, which hid it. ADR 0010 rests on the same assumption (ready means init seen) and needs a new signal for telling a missing login from a slow start.

Adding a repository by typing its path into a text field meets the ticket's goal only in the letter. The developer asked for an explorer-style picker, and pointing at a path is what the ticket actually says. A browser cannot hand over an absolute path, so this is a server-side directory listing: a new route, a new wire type and a change to the client contract.
